newsitem.title: BULGARIA: LEV ENDS FLAT AS BULGARIA RECEIVES IMF FUNDING.
newsitem.headline: LEV ENDS FLAT AS BULGARIA RECEIVES IMF FUNDING.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,504-1,506 per dollar in light interbank trade, steady on the opening's 1,503-1,508 as disbursement of $178.7 million from the IMF was not expected to boost it sharply, traders said.
"The lev idled range bound near opening levels throughout the day in light volumes," a commercial bank dealer said.

Traders did not expect a sharp lev rise following today's announcement that the International Monetary Fund (IMF) had disbursed $178.7 million under a $657 million funding package for Bulgaria approved last week.
"Any sharp lev gains are not anticipated because the news has already been priced in. Exchange rate movements will continue to depend on the central bank," another dealer said.

The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) has been a net dollar buyer since February, boosting its reserves and containing a sharp lev rise amid higher foreign currency supply from commercial banks and clients.

The BNB said $31.704 million of the disbursement were the first tranche of the $510 million 14-month standby and $147.043 million were a Compensatory and Contingency Financing Facility (CCFF) loan to fund grain imports. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
